mapper.sql: id, english_name, NULL AS japanese_name, anime_title, role_type AS archetype, energy AS element, image_url, tags AS quote, popularity_score AS popularity, create_time, enabled
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sekai_Draw_lots_character WHERE enabled = TRUE AND role_type <> 'archived'
SELECT FROM sekai_Draw_lots_character WHERE enabled = TRUE AND role_type <> 'archived' ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM sekai_Draw_lots_character WHERE enabled = TRUE AND role_type <> 'archived' AND ( energy LIKE CONCAT('%', #{focus}, '%') OR tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{focus}, '%') OR role_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{focus}, '%') OR anime_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{focus}, '%') ) ORDER BY popularity_score DESC, RAND() LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sekai_Draw_lots_character WHERE enabled = TRUE AND role_type <> 'archived' ORDER BY popularity_score DESC, id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM sekai_Draw_lots_character
enabled = TRUE AND role_type <> 'archived'
AND ( english_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR anime_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR role_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR energy LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY popularity_score DESC, id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id, c.english_name, NULL AS japanese_name, c.anime_title, c.role_type AS archetype, c.energy AS element, c.image_url, c.tags AS quote, c.popularity_score AS popularity, c.create_time FROM sekai_Draw_lots_character c JOIN sekai_Draw_lots_character base ON base.id = #{baseId} WHERE c.id != base.id AND c.enabled = TRUE AND c.role_type <> 'archived' ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.anime_title = base.anime_title THEN 50 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.role_type = base.role_type THEN 24 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.energy = base.energy THEN 18 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN c.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', base.role_type, '%') OR base.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', c.role_type, '%') THEN 10 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sekai_Draw_lots_record r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.character_id = c.id AND r.fortune_score >= 82 ) THEN 16 ELSE 0 END DESC, c.popularity_score DESC, c.id LIMIT #{limit}
